name: LoungeSMP
description:
Active Semi-vanilla SMP, no resets, weekly events, player shops, jobs, warps, keep inventory, and toggle PvP off by default. Join for a unique adventure, stay for the amazing community. Java + Bedrock Supported, beginner friendly and helpful community. Join Our public SMP today!

What makes it different?

➡️ Strong, welcoming community (people actually talk and play together)

➡️ Vanilla-style gameplay with quality-of-life features

➡️ Active staff + ongoing development (we’re always improving things)

➡️ Weekly events like Spleef, Parkour, and more

➡️ A place to chill — whether you're building, grinding, or just hanging out

Features

➡️ Toggle PvP (off by default)

➡️ Keep Inventory

➡️ Player economy (/shop, jobs, player shops, warps)

➡️ No world resets — your progress actually matters

If you want a server that feels alive without ruining the core game, this is it.
